title: Cover Concrete Wall Outdoor | Backyard Before & After
description: Looking for a way to cover a concrete or block wall in your backyard? See how this project transformed it with stone. Real before and after.
text:
An Easy Way to Cover an Ugly Backyard Wall
See how this homeowner transformed a plain concrete wall into a finished stone feature—without tearing anything out.

Rob Dean

Senior Project Coordinator

Hi, I’m Rob, and I worked with this homeowner in Florida on a simple backyard upgrade.

The concrete wall along the yard felt unfinished and didn’t match the rest of the outdoor space. It stood out visually and took away from the overall look.

The homeowner wasn’t looking for a major project—they just wanted a clean way to cover the wall and make the space feel more complete.

See What Your Home Could Look Like

Covering a Concrete Wall Without Rebuilding It
Update a Concrete Block Wall • Installs Over Concrete Block

Instead of removing the existing wall, we installed stone directly over it—creating a finished look that blends naturally into the yard.

✅ Installed directly over concrete block

✅ No demolition required

✅ Completed in days, not weeks

From Plain Concrete to a Finished Backyard Feature
A simple upgrade turned this builder-grade exterior into a clean, custom look adding depth, contrast, and a high-end finish without major construction.

Before

The Goal

- Bare concrete block wall

- Looked unfinished

- Didn’t match the yard

- Reduced overall backyard appeal

- Visually distracting

After

The Solution

- Cover wall with stone veneer

- Create a natural, finished look

- Add texture and warmth

- Blend into landscaping

- Turn it into a feature instead of a flaw

What Does It Cost to Cover a Backyard Wall Like This?

Projects like this typically range between $1,500–$5,000, depending on size and layout. This is often much more affordable than rebuilding or replacing the wall entirely.

Try Visualizer Get Your Project Estimate

Project Details

- Products Used: Panels

- Color: Desert Sunrise

- Install: Over Concrete Block

Can This Be Installed on Retaining Walls?

Yes, GenStone can be installed over any flat surface as long as the substrate is sturdy and will not move. To install over block, simply use Tapcon screws and construction adhesive.

Will It Hold Up Outdoors in Weather?

Yes, GenStone is engineered to withstand the elements and perform like any other siding product.

Is This Better Than Painting or Staining Concrete?

Yes, with or paint or stain you will be left with a flat concrete like surface whereas with GenStone, you will not only add color, but also texture and depth.

Desert Sunrise Color Guide

This color was chosen to create contrast and give the wall a natural stone appearance that blends into the surrounding landscape.
